example.hanzi: 这个房间小而干净。
example.pinyin: Zhè gè fáng jiān xiǎo ér gān jìng.
example.english: This room is small yet clean.

example.hanzi: 这个问题与我的工作没有关系。
example.pinyin: Zhè gè wèn tí yǔ wǒ de gōng zuò méi yǒu guān xi.
example.english: This issue has nothing to do with my work.

example.hanzi: 哥哥去年在一家大公司当经理。
example.pinyin: Gē ge qù nián zài yī jiā dà gōng sī dāng jīng lǐ.
example.english: My older brother worked as a manager at a big company last year.

example.hanzi: 三分之一的学生来了。
example.pinyin: Sān fēn zhī yī de xué sheng lái le.
example.english: One third of the students came.

example.hanzi: 他以跑步来锻炼身体。
example.pinyin: Tā yǐ pǎo bù lái duàn liàn shēn tǐ.
example.english: He exercises his body by jogging.

example.hanzi: 公园里的那棵树死了。
example.pinyin: Gōng yuán lǐ de nà kē shù sǐ le.
example.english: That tree in the park died.

example.hanzi: 太阳出来了，天气却很冷。
example.pinyin: Tài yang chū lái le, tiān qì què hěn lěng.
example.english: The sun came out, yet the weather is very cold.

example.hanzi: 他在北京生活了五年，非常习惯这里。
example.pinyin: Tā zài Běi jīng shēng huó le wǔ nián, fēi cháng xí guàn zhè lǐ.
example.english: He has lived in Beijing for five years and feels right at home here.

words.english: To happen; to occur; to take place; to break out

example.hanzi: 公共汽车上发生什么了？
example.pinyin: Gōng gòng qì chē shàng fā shēng shén me le?
example.english: What happened on the bus?

example.hanzi: 那家饭店离学校很远，不过菜特别好吃。
example.pinyin: Nà jiā fàn diàn lí xué xiào hěn yuǎn, bù guò cài tè bié hǎo chī.
example.english: That restaurant is far from the school, though the food is delicious.

words.english: All / to have; to possess; to own

example.hanzi: 我可以回答所有问题。
example.pinyin: Wǒ kě yǐ huí dá suǒ yǒu wèn tí.
example.english: I can answer all the questions.

example.hanzi: 请告诉我大家现在的工作情况。
example.pinyin: Qǐng gào su wǒ dà jiā xiàn zài de gōng zuò qíng kuàng.
example.english: Please tell me how everyone's work is going right now.

example.hanzi: 她努力学习，希望能成为好医生。
example.pinyin: Tā nǔ lì xué xí, xī wàng néng chéng wéi hǎo yī shēng.
example.english: She studies hard and hopes to become a good doctor.

example.hanzi: 我们明天上午九点在公园见面，行吗？
example.pinyin: Wǒ men míng tiān shàng wǔ jiǔ diǎn zài gōng yuán jiàn miàn, xíng ma?
example.english: Shall we meet at the park at nine tomorrow morning—does that work?

words.english: Feeling; impression; sensation / to feel; to perceive

example.hanzi: 我今天感觉很舒服。
example.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān gǎn jué hěn shū fu.
example.english: I feel very comfortable today.

example.hanzi: 准备好继续了吗？
example.pinyin: Zhǔn bèi hǎo jì xù le ma?
example.english: Are you ready to continue?

words.english: Large place used for a specific purpose / stage

example.hanzi: 昨天那场体育比赛大家都很喜欢。
example.pinyin: Zuó tiān nà chǎng tǐ yù bǐ sài dà jiā dōu hěn xǐ huan.
example.english: Everyone really enjoyed that sports match yesterday.

example.hanzi: 比赛正在顺利地进行。
example.pinyin: Bǐ sài zhèng zài shùn lì de jìn xíng.
example.english: The match is proceeding smoothly.

example.hanzi: 一个小时内就能到机场。
example.pinyin: Yī gè xiǎo shí nèi jiù néng dào jī chǎng.
example.english: We can arrive at the airport within an hour.

example.hanzi: 问题是怎么出现的？
example.pinyin: Wèn tí shì zěn me chū xiàn de?
example.english: How did the problem occur?

words.english: To pass through; to get through

example.hanzi: 他考试通过了吗？
example.pinyin: Tā kǎo shì tōng guò le ma?
example.english: Did he pass the exam?

example.hanzi: 教室里空无一人。
example.pinyin: Jiào shì lǐ kōng wú yī rén.
example.english: There isn't a single person in the classroom.

example.hanzi: 我希望最后一切都好。
example.pinyin: Wǒ xī wàng zuì hòu yī qiè dōu hǎo.
example.english: I hope everything will be fine in the end.

example.hanzi: 这件事情由我来做，你放心吧。
example.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì qing yóu wǒ lái zuò, nǐ fàng xīn ba.
example.english: Leave this to me—you don't need to worry.

example.hanzi: 没有任何干净的盘子。
example.pinyin: Méi yǒu rèn hé gān jìng de pán zi.
example.english: There are no clean plates.

example.hanzi: 安全是最重要的事情。
example.pinyin: Ān quán shì zuì zhòng yào de shì qing.
example.english: Safety is what matters most.

example.hanzi: 他对结果不满意。
example.pinyin: Tā duì jié guǒ bù mǎn yì.
example.english: He is unsatisfied with the result.

example.hanzi: 这个问题我现在完全明白了。
example.pinyin: Zhè gè wèn tí wǒ xiàn zài wán quán míng bai le.
example.english: I completely understand this question now.

example.hanzi: 经常跑步锻炼使他的身体更健康。
example.pinyin: Jīng cháng pǎo bù duàn liàn shǐ tā de shēn tǐ gèng jiàn kāng.
example.english: Jogging and exercising regularly makes his body healthier.

example.hanzi: 明天有什么计划？
example.pinyin: Míng tiān yǒu shén me jì huà?
example.english: What's the plan for tomorrow?

example.hanzi: 我想去旅游，可是没有时间。
example.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù lǚ yóu, kě shì méi yǒu shí jiān.
example.english: I want to travel, but I don't have time.

example.hanzi: 连小孩子都知道这件事情。
example.pinyin: Lián xiǎo hái zi dōu zhī dào zhè jiàn shì qing.
example.english: Even little kids know about this.

example.hanzi: 你今天想去哪儿呀？
example.pinyin: Nǐ jīn tiān xiǎng qù nǎ r ya?
example.english: Where do you want to go today?

example.hanzi: 你刚说的是什么地方？
example.pinyin: Nǐ gāng shuō de shì shén me dì fang?
example.english: What place were you just talking about?

example.hanzi: 我不知道他今天迟到的原因。
example.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhī dào tā jīn tiān chí dào de yuán yīn.
example.english: I don't know why he was late today.

example.hanzi: 这消息让她很高兴。
example.pinyin: Zhè xiāo xi ràng tā hěn gāo xìng.
example.english: The news made her happy.

example.hanzi: 你只要努力就可以了。
example.pinyin: Nǐ zhǐ yào nǔ lì jiù kě yǐ le.
example.english: You only have to try hard.

example.hanzi: 他在那家公司干了三年，工作一直很认真。
example.pinyin: Tā zài nà jiā gōng sī gàn le sān nián, gōng zuò yī zhí hěn rèn zhēn.
example.english: He worked at that company for three years and was always diligent.

example.hanzi: 他接受了她的礼物。
example.pinyin: Tā jiē shòu le tā de lǐ wù.
example.english: He accepted her gift.

example.hanzi: 我最喜欢其中那本小说。
example.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐ huan qí zhōng nà běn xiǎo shuō.
example.english: Among them, I like that novel the most.

example.hanzi: 只要认真准备，这次比赛一定会成功。
example.pinyin: Zhǐ yào rèn zhēn zhǔn bèi, zhè cì bǐ sài yī dìng huì chéng gōng.
example.english: As long as we prepare carefully, this competition is sure to succeed.

example.hanzi: 他甚至连自己的生日都忘记了。
example.pinyin: Tā shèn zhì lián zì jǐ de shēng rì dōu wàng jì le.
example.english: He even forgot his own birthday.

words.english: To pull / to play (a bowed instrument)

example.hanzi: 他拉着那个大行李箱走进了机场。
example.pinyin: Tā lā zhe nà gè dà xíng li xiāng zǒu jìn le jī chǎng.
example.english: He pulled that big suitcase as he walked into the airport.

words.english: Regarding; as far as (sth) is concerned; with regard to

example.hanzi: 对于这个计划大家都同意。
example.pinyin: Duì yú zhè gè jì huà dà jiā dōu tóng yì.
example.english: Everyone agrees on this plan.

words.english: To be certain / to be positive

example.hanzi: 我肯定你会成功。
example.pinyin: Wǒ kěn dìng nǐ huì chéng gōng.
example.english: I'm sure you'll succeed.

example.hanzi: 发生那件事情的时候，我当时就在旁边。
example.pinyin: Fā shēng nà jiàn shì qing de shí hou, wǒ dāng shí jiù zài páng biān.
example.english: When that happened, I was right nearby at the time.

example.hanzi: 一直走到前面，再往右边转就是银行。
example.pinyin: Yī zhí zǒu dào qián miàn, zài wǎng yòu bian zhuǎn jiù shì yín háng.
example.english: Walk straight ahead and turn right—the bank is right there.

example.hanzi: 学校正在调查学生周末上网的时间。
example.pinyin: Xué xiào zhèng zài diào chá xué sheng zhōu mò shàng wǎng de shí jiān.
example.english: The school is surveying how much time students spend online on weekends.

example.hanzi: 我只看完了一部分。
example.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ kàn wán le yī bù fen.
example.english: I only finished reading a part of it.

example.hanzi: 多练习能很快提高你的汉语能力。
example.pinyin: Duō liàn xí néng hěn kuài tí gāo nǐ de Hàn yǔ néng lì.
example.english: Practicing more can quickly improve your Chinese skills.

example.hanzi: 晚上看书要开灯，注意保护眼睛。
example.pinyin: Wǎn shang kàn shū yào kāi dēng, zhù yì bǎo hù yǎn jing.
example.english: Turn on the light when reading at night and protect your eyes.

example.hanzi: 我昨天才懂了她真正的意思。
example.pinyin: Wǒ zuó tiān cái dǒng le tā zhēn zhèng de yì si.
example.english: It was only yesterday that I realized what she really meant.

words.english: To be in favor of / to support

example.hanzi: 爸爸妈妈一直非常支持我的决定。
example.pinyin: Bà ba mā ma yī zhí fēi cháng zhī chí wǒ de jué dìng.
example.english: My parents have always strongly supported my decision.

example.hanzi: 他开始掉头发了。
example.pinyin: Tā kāi shǐ diào tóu fa le.
example.english: He is beginning to lose his hair.

example.hanzi: 科学改变了我们的生活。
example.pinyin: Kē xué gǎi biàn le wǒ men de shēng huó.
example.english: Science has changed our life.

example.hanzi: 我怀疑他是否会来。
example.pinyin: Wǒ huái yí tā shì fǒu huì lái.
example.english: I am doubtful whether he will come.

example.hanzi: 两个会议同时开始了。
example.pinyin: Liǎng gè huì yì tóng shí kāi shǐ le.
example.english: The two meetings started at the same time.

example.hanzi: 他以为什么都知道。
example.pinyin: Tā yǐ wéi shén me dōu zhī dào.
example.english: He thinks he knows everything.

example.hanzi: 爬山是锻炼的好方法。
example.pinyin: Pá shān shì duàn liàn de hǎo fāng fǎ.
example.english: Hiking is a great way to exercise.

example.hanzi: 你最近在研究什么？
example.pinyin: Nǐ zuì jìn zài yán jiū shén me?
example.english: What are you researching lately?

example.hanzi: 我向你保证，下次上课一定不迟到。
example.pinyin: Wǒ xiàng nǐ bǎo zhèng, xià cì shàng kè yī dìng bù chí dào.
example.english: I promise you I definitely won't be late for class next time.

example.hanzi: 这与你有直接关系。
example.pinyin: Zhè yǔ nǐ yǒu zhí jiē guān xi.
example.english: This directly concerns you.

example.hanzi: 我们可能永远不知道。
example.pinyin: Wǒ men kě néng yǒng yuǎn bù zhī dào.
example.english: We may never know.

example.hanzi: 这也许是我们最后的会议。
example.pinyin: Zhè yě xǔ shì wǒ men zuì hòu de huì yì.
example.english: This may be our last meeting.

example.hanzi: 在学习汉语方面，小王帮助了我很多。
example.pinyin: Zài xué xí Hàn yǔ fāng miàn, Xiǎo Wáng bāng zhù le wǒ hěn duō.
example.english: Xiao Wang has helped me a lot with learning Chinese.

example.hanzi: 周末学校有一次文化活动。
example.pinyin: Zhōu mò xué xiào yǒu yī cì wén huà huó dòng.
example.english: There is a cultural event at school this weekend.

example.hanzi: 你的建议值得考虑。
example.pinyin: Nǐ de jiàn yì zhí de kǎo lǜ.
example.english: Your suggestion is worth considering.

example.hanzi: 我找到了一份新工作。
example.pinyin: Wǒ zhǎo dào le yī fèn xīn gōng zuò.
example.english: I found a new job.

example.hanzi: 我得了重感冒。
example.pinyin: Wǒ dé le zhòng gǎn mào.
example.english: I caught a bad cold.

example.hanzi: 这是条有趣的信息。
example.pinyin: Zhè shì tiáo yǒu qù de xìn xī.
example.english: That's an interesting piece of information.

example.hanzi: 这家宾馆提供免费饮料。
example.pinyin: Zhè jiā bīn guǎn tí gōng miǎn fèi yǐn liào.
example.english: This hotel provides free drinks.

words.english: Finger / to point at or to

example.hanzi: 我不知道你指的是什么。
example.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhī dào nǐ zhǐ de shì shén me.
example.english: I don't know what you're referring to.

example.hanzi: 你知道怎么使用这台新电脑吗？
example.pinyin: Nǐ zhī dào zěn me shǐ yòng zhè tái xīn diàn nǎo ma?
example.english: Do you know how to use this new computer?

words.english: To come from (a place) / From: (in email header)

example.hanzi: 我们班的新同学来自法国巴黎。
example.pinyin: Wǒ men bān de xīn tóng xué lái zì Fǎ guó Bā lí.
example.english: The new student in our class is from Paris, France.

example.hanzi: 这是个不可能的任务。
example.pinyin: Zhè shì gè bù kě néng de rèn wu.
example.english: This is an impossible task.

example.hanzi: 我希望大家都开心。
example.pinyin: Wǒ xī wàng dà jiā dōu kāi xīn.
example.english: I hope everyone is happy.

example.hanzi: 到了机场请马上打电话跟我联系。
example.pinyin: Dào le jī chǎng qǐng mǎ shàng dǎ diàn huà gēn wǒ lián xì.
example.english: Please call and get in touch with me as soon as you reach the airport.

example.hanzi: 路上堵车，因此我迟到了。
example.pinyin: Lù shàng dǔ chē, yīn cǐ wǒ chí dào le.
example.english: There was a traffic jam on the road, so I arrived late.

example.hanzi: 我买了一台新电脑。
example.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le yī tái xīn diàn nǎo.
example.english: I bought a new computer.

words.english: To obtain; to receive; to get

example.hanzi: 她努力工作获得了成功。
example.pinyin: Tā nǔ lì gōng zuò huò dé le chéng gōng.
example.english: She worked hard and achieved success.

words.english: To leave (a message etc) / to retain

example.hanzi: 姐姐在桌子上给我留了一块蛋糕。
example.pinyin: Jiě jie zài zhuō zi shàng gěi wǒ liú le yī kuài dàn gāo.
example.english: My older sister left a piece of cake for me on the table.

example.hanzi: 水对每个人的生命都非常重要。
example.pinyin: Shuǐ duì měi gè rén de shēng mìng dōu fēi cháng zhòng yào.
example.english: Water is vital to every person's life.

example.hanzi: 来北京留学，我交到了很多新朋友。
example.pinyin: Lái Běi jīng liú xué, wǒ jiāo dào le hěn duō xīn péng you.
example.english: While studying abroad in Beijing, I made many new friends.

example.hanzi: 我已经把今天的作业全部写完了。
example.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ jīn tiān de zuò yè quán bù xiě wán le.
example.english: I've already finished all of today's homework.

example.hanzi: 刚到新环境有点不习惯是很正常的。
example.pinyin: Gāng dào xīn huán jìng yǒu diǎn bù xí guàn shì hěn zhèng cháng de.
example.english: Feeling a bit unaccustomed when you first arrive in a new environment is completely normal.

example.hanzi: 除了跑步，她另外还喜欢游泳。
example.pinyin: Chú le pǎo bù, tā lìng wài hái xǐ huan yóu yǒng.
example.english: Besides jogging, she also likes swimming.

example.hanzi: 今天天气挺冷的。
example.pinyin: Jīn tiān tiān qì tǐng lěng de.
example.english: It's rather cold today.

example.hanzi: 他今天好像生病了。
example.pinyin: Tā jīn tiān hǎo xiàng shēng bìng le.
example.english: It seems he got sick today.

example.hanzi: 那到底是什么声音？
example.pinyin: Nà dào dǐ shì shén me shēng yīn?
example.english: What on earth is that noise?

example.hanzi: 非常感谢您这段时间对我的帮助！
example.pinyin: Fēi cháng gǎn xiè nín zhè duàn shí jiān duì wǒ de bāng zhù!
example.english: Thank you so much for all your help during this time!

example.hanzi: 你在哪座城市呀？
example.pinyin: Nǐ zài nǎ zuò chéng shì ya?
example.english: In which city are you?

words.english: To persevere with / to persist in

example.hanzi: 她坚持让我去看医生。
example.pinyin: Tā jiān chí ràng wǒ qù kàn yī shēng.
example.english: She insisted that I should see the doctor.

example.hanzi: 电脑技术发展得非常快。
example.pinyin: Diàn nǎo jì shù fā zhǎn de fēi cháng kuài.
example.english: Computer technology is developing very fast.

example.hanzi: 公共汽车在超市前面停下了。
example.pinyin: Gōng gòng qì chē zài chāo shì qián miàn tíng xià le.
example.english: The bus stopped in front of the supermarket.

example.hanzi: 桌子上的杯子不小心倒了。
example.pinyin: Zhuō zi shàng de bēi zi bù xiǎo xīn dǎo le.
example.english: The cup on the table accidentally tipped over.

words.english: To propose; to suggest; to recommend

example.hanzi: 您建议我做什么？
example.pinyin: Nín jiàn yì wǒ zuò shén me?
example.english: What do you advise me to do?

example.hanzi: 情况比您想的要严重。
example.pinyin: Qíng kuàng bǐ nín xiǎng de yào yán zhòng.
example.english: The situation is more serious than you think.

example.hanzi: 原来你也是小李的老同学啊！
example.pinyin: Yuán lái nǐ yě shì Xiǎo Lǐ de lǎo tóng xué a!
example.english: So you're an old classmate of Xiao Li's too!

example.hanzi: 为什么月亮晚上发光？
example.pinyin: Wèi shén me yuè liang wǎn shang fā guāng?
example.english: Why does the moon shine at night?

example.hanzi: 我们每个人都应该了解国家的法律。
example.pinyin: Wǒ men měi gè rén dōu yīng gāi liǎo jiě guó jiā de fǎ lǜ.
example.english: Every one of us should understand the laws of the country.

example.hanzi: 我的父亲在医院工作了二十年。
example.pinyin: Wǒ de fù qīn zài yī yuàn gōng zuò le èr shí nián.
example.english: My father has worked at the hospital for twenty years.

example.hanzi: 他聪明并且非常认真。
example.pinyin: Tā cōng ming bìng qiě fēi cháng rèn zhēn.
example.english: He is clever and also very conscientious.

example.hanzi: 我昨天收到了你的礼物。
example.pinyin: Wǒ zuó tiān shōu dào le nǐ de lǐ wù.
example.english: I received your gift yesterday.

example.hanzi: 现在的社会变化得非常快。
